New Westminster condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings, from the MLS®. Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
New Westminster market context, June to September 2026

New Westminster had 164 houses and 444 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 9 and 67 sold in the month. Condos are a smaller part of those listings, so the market-wide figures below are the closest published read on the price pressure around them.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

items.t: New Westminster real estate market stats

faq.q: Is New Westminster a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in New Westminster had a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in New Westminster?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in New Westminster that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when condos come up in New Westminster?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all New Westminster homes?
faq.a: The New Westminster homes for sale page covers every home type, and the New Westminster market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so any count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
